opennyai_summary.decision:
The petitioner seeks leave to assail the order dated 24.8.2023 passed by the High Court of Punjab &
Haryana at Chandigarh in CRM-M No. 26429 of 2022 (O&M) whereunder his application for anticipatory bail was rejected.
2s This Court, on 6.12.2023, while issuing notice, passed an interim order to the effect that no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner, which interim order was extended on 16.2.2024.
Having heard learned counsel on both sides, we make the interim order passed on 6.12.2023 absolute subject to further proceedings emanating from the subject FIR.
The special leave petition is disposed of, as above.
Pending application(s), if any, stands disposed of.
